statements: DOJ states that a separate laptop-farm, stolen-identity, and shell-company scheme enabled overseas IT workers, including DPRK workers, to obtain work at more than 100 U.S. companies, including an unnamed defense contractor. The employer-specific access and impact are not public.
defensive_controls: Defense contractors should verify remote device custody and detect out-of-band remote control or domestic proxy hosting.
Identity assurance must include repeated identity continuity, not just a one-time document check.
Do not publish or speculate about the unnamed contractor.
